parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "matchScore": {{ $json.matchScore }},
  "summary": {{ JSON.stringify("[LỊCH PHỎNG VẤN CHÍNH THỨC]: " + $json.dateTimeFormatted + " - " + $json.locationText + ". Người liên hệ: " + $json.contactPerson.name + " (" + $json.contactPerson.phone + ").") }},
  "parsedSkillsJson": {
    "skills": {{ JSON.stringify($json.skills) }},
    "coreSkills": {{ JSON.stringify($json.coreSkills || []) }},
    "secondarySkills": {{ JSON.stringify($json.secondarySkills || []) }},
    "systemScaleScore": {{ $json.systemScaleScore || 75 }},
    "githubUrl": {{ JSON.stringify($json.githubUrl || null) }},
    "keywordStuffingFlag": {{ $json.keywordStuffingFlag ? true : false }},
    "interviewKit": {{ JSON.stringify($json.interviewKit || []) }},
    "interviewSchedule": {
      "status": "SCHEDULED",
      "type": {{ JSON.stringify($json.interviewType) }},
      "time": {{ JSON.stringify($json.dateTimeFormatted) }},
      "location": {{ JSON.stringify($json.locationText) }},
      "googleMeetUrl": {{ JSON.stringify($json.googleMeetUrl) }},
      "isRealGoogleMeet": {{ $json.isRealGoogleMeet }},
      "googleCalendarEventId": {{ JSON.stringify($json.googleCalendarEventId) }},
      "googleCalendarHtmlLink": {{ JSON.stringify($json.googleCalendarHtmlLink) }},
      "interviewer": {{ JSON.stringify($json.leadInterviewer) }}
    }
  }
}
